licoes.titulo: I used to be the quiet one
licoes.objectivo: Contrastar hábitos e estados do passado com o presente, com used to e usually.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: I [used to] live in Lubango, but now I live in Luanda.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: I didn't [use] to speak English.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: Did you [use] to work on Saturdays?

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: I [lived] in Lubango for twenty years.
exercicios.explicacao: Para "quanto tempo", o past simple, não used to.

exercicios.enunciado: "Costumo beber café de manhã." Em inglês:

opcoes.texto: I usually drink coffee in the morning.
I use to drink coffee in the morning.
I used to drink coffee in the morning.

exercicios.explicacao: used to é só para o passado; um hábito de agora é usually.

exercicios.enunciado: Choose the correct sentence.

opcoes.texto: I used to go to Benguela in 2019.
I use to go to Benguela in 2019.

exercicios.enunciado: "Do you still dance kizomba?" Sílvia stopped. She says:

opcoes.texto: Not any more. I used to dance every Saturday.
Yes, I used to dance every Saturday.
No, I use to dance every Saturday.

exercicios.enunciado: Eu era muito nervoso ao telefone.
exercicios.resposta: I used to be very nervous on the phone.

exercicios.frase: I'm Thandi. When I lived in Luanda, I used to come to this café every Friday.
exercicios.enunciado: How often did Thandi use to come to the café?

exercicios.frase: I used to be really nervous on the phone.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita: "used to" sem som de "d".
Tell me about your life ten years ago: three habits with "used to", and what is different now.
exercicios.frase: used to
exercicios.resposta: Ten years ago, I used to live with my parents in Huambo. I used to walk to school, and I used to play basketball every afternoon. Now I live in Luanda, and I drive to work.

exercicios.enunciado: Did you use to speak English at school? What about now?
exercicios.frase: use to
exercicios.resposta: No, I didn't use to speak English at school. I used to read it, but I never spoke it. Now I usually speak English at work every week.

licoes.titulo: I've been working on it since August
licoes.objectivo: Falar de actividades que começaram no passado e continuam, com o present perfect continuous e How long…?

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: I've been [reading] the logs since seven o'clock.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: How long have you [been] working on it?

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: Hannah's team [has] been sending us data every day.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: I've known you [since] January.

exercicios.enunciado: "Trabalho nisto há dois meses." Em inglês:

opcoes.texto: I've been working on this for two months.
I work on this for two months.
I'm working on this for two months.

exercicios.enunciado: Choose the correct sentence.
"You look tired." Choose the best question.

opcoes.texto: Did you work late since Monday?
Are you working late since Monday?

exercicios.enunciado: Estou à espera há uma hora.
exercicios.resposta: I've been waiting for an hour.

exercicios.frase: I'm Nuno. I've been working on the Morro Azul problem since August — almost two months.
exercicios.enunciado: How long has Nuno been working on the problem?

exercicios.frase: I've been reading the logs since seven o'clock.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita: "been" curto e fraco.
What have you been doing at work or in your studies recently? Talk about two activities, and say how long.
exercicios.frase: been
exercicios.resposta: Recently I've been preparing the budget for next year. I've been working on it for three weeks. I've also been training two new colleagues since September.
exercicios.contexto: Duas actividades e há quanto tempo.

exercicios.enunciado: How long have you been learning English? And how long have you been in your job?
exercicios.frase: I've been
exercicios.resposta: I've been learning English since 2025, and I've been working at the bank for four years.

licoes.objectivo: Escolher entre o present perfect continuous (actividade) e o simple (resultado, quantos).

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: I've [written] two pages so far.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: I've been [working] on it since lunch.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: I've [visited] the plant twice.

exercicios.enunciado: Choose the correct sentence.

opcoes.texto: I've called the client three times today.
I've been calling the client three times today.
I'm calling the client three times today.

exercicios.enunciado: Choose the best question.

opcoes.texto: How many emails have you sent?
How many emails have you been sending?
How many emails are you sending since Monday?

exercicios.enunciado: "I've been painting the office." The work is…
"I've painted the office." The work is…
Which two sentences mean almost the same?

opcoes.texto: I've worked here since 2026. / I've been working here since 2026.
I've written a report. / I've been writing a report.
I've visited Namibe. / I've been visiting Namibe.

exercicios.frase: This is Nuno. I've worked on two big projects this year: Mussulo Energy and now Morro Azul.
exercicios.enunciado: How many big projects has Nuno worked on this year?

exercicios.frase: I've written two pages. I've been working on it since lunch.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita, com o acento em "two" e em "lunch".
Talk about your year: one long activity, and two results with numbers.
exercicios.frase: I've
exercicios.resposta: This year I've been working on a new accounting system since February. I've trained twelve colleagues, and I've written three manuals.
exercicios.contexto: Continuous para a actividade; simple para os resultados.

exercicios.enunciado: A colleague asks: "How's your report going?" Answer with the activity and the result.
exercicios.frase: I've been
exercicios.resposta: I've been writing it all morning, and I've finished the first part. I've written about four pages.

licoes.objectivo: Verbos de mudança, adjectivos em -ed / -ing; retire e deception.

exercicios.enunciado: Ligue cada verbo à tradução.

pares.b: mudar de casa ou de cidade

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: The instructions were very [confusing].

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: I was [surprised] by the results.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: The first month was [frustrating].

exercicios.enunciado: "I'm boring in meetings" means…
Choose the correct sentence.

opcoes.texto: I'm really interested in the project.
I'm really interesting in the project.
I'm really interest in the project.

exercicios.enunciado: "O meu pai reformou-se no ano passado." Em inglês:
exercicios.explicacao: retire = reformar-se; retirar dinheiro = take out / withdraw money.

exercicios.enunciado: "Foi uma grande decepção." Em inglês:
Kevin says: "I'm getting used to it." He means…

opcoes.texto: It's starting to feel normal for him.
He did it in the past.
He doesn't like it at all.

exercicios.frase: How long have you been waiting?
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita, com "have" e "been" fracos.
Describe a big change in your life or work. How did you feel at the start, and how do you feel now?
exercicios.frase: feel
exercicios.resposta: Two years ago, I moved from Benguela to Luanda for a new job. At the start I was worried, and the traffic was frustrating. But I've adapted, and now I feel happy here.

exercicios.enunciado: Did you give up a habit or take up a new activity recently? Tell me about it.
exercicios.frase: up
exercicios.resposta: Last year I gave up sugar in my coffee. And in March I took up running. I've been running three times a week, and I feel great.

licoes.titulo: Real English: How my life has changed
licoes.objectivo: Identificar a mudança, a razão e o sentimento em quatro testemunhos.

exercicios.frase: I'm Esperança. I taught teenagers at a secondary school in Malanje for twelve years.
exercicios.enunciado: How long did Esperança teach in Malanje?

exercicios.frase: This is Esperança. In August I started a new job here in Luanda: I teach English to bank staff.
exercicios.enunciado: Who does Esperança teach now?

exercicios.frase: I'm Kevin. We had a baby, and I wanted to be at home every night. So now I work in an office in Luanda.
exercicios.enunciado: Why did Kevin change jobs?

opcoes.texto: He wanted to be at home every night.

exercicios.frase: This is Kevin. Honestly, the first month in the office was frustrating. I didn't use to sit at a desk all day!
exercicios.enunciado: How did Kevin feel in his first month in the office?

exercicios.frase: I'm Patrick. In June I became a team manager. I used to do everything myself; now I give the jobs to other people.
exercicios.enunciado: What changed for Patrick in June?

exercicios.frase: I'm Mei. Four years ago, I moved to Lusaka, and now I work for a small company: we're only thirty.
exercicios.enunciado: How many people work at Mei's company?
In the four stories, each person talks about…
Kevin says: "I didn't use to sit at a desk all day." It means:

opcoes.texto: Before, he didn't sit at a desk all day.
He sat at a desk all day before, and he still does.
He never sits at a desk.

exercicios.frase: I've been doing it for two months now.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita em voz alta.

exercicios.frase: Some days it's confusing, but I'm improving.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita em voz alta.
Tell me about a change in your work: before, now, and how you feel.
exercicios.frase: used to
exercicios.resposta: I used to work in a small office in Lobito. Now I work at the head office in Luanda. I've been here since January. At first it was confusing, but now I'm really happy.

exercicios.enunciado: Which of the four changes is the most difficult, in your opinion? Why?
exercicios.frase: difficult
exercicios.resposta: I think Patrick's change is the most difficult, because he has to trust other people, and he's learning Portuguese at the same time.

licoes.objectivo: Falar do ano de trabalho com a chefia e resumir em inglês uma avaliação escrita em português.

exercicios.enunciado: Lerato asks: "How has your job changed this year?" Choose the best start.

opcoes.texto: When I started, I used to support the staff in our office. Now I'm in the joint team.
When I started, I use to support the staff. Now I am in the joint team.
When I started, I've supported the staff. Now I'm in the joint team.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: Since August, I've been [working] on the Morro Azul project.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: I've [visited] the plant in Namibe twice.

exercicios.enunciado: Complete a frase.
exercicios.frase: The first months in the joint team were [tiring].

exercicios.enunciado: The evaluation says: "evoluiu muito". Nuno says:

opcoes.texto: He says I've improved a lot.
He says I've evolutioned a lot.
He says I improve a lot since.

exercicios.enunciado: The evaluation says: "A melhorar: os relatórios escritos". Nuno says:

opcoes.texto: And one thing to improve: my written reports.

exercicios.enunciado: A good answer about your year has…

opcoes.texto: before, now and the next step

exercicios.frase: This is Lerato. Mr Baptista sent me your evaluation, but it's in Portuguese. Could you tell me what it says?
exercicios.enunciado: What does Lerato ask Nuno to do?

exercicios.frase: I'm Nuno. Next year, I'd like to lead a small project, and I'd like to take the B1 exam in December.
exercicios.enunciado: When does Nuno want to take the B1 exam?

exercicios.frase: When I started, I used to support the staff in our office. Now I'm in the joint team.
exercicios.enunciado: Ouça e repita, com uma pausa entre as duas partes.
It's your annual review. How has your job or your studies changed this year?
exercicios.frase: used to
exercicios.resposta: When I started, I used to answer the phone and organise meetings. Now I manage the office budget. I've been doing it since March, and I've saved about ten percent. At first it was worrying, but now I'm confident.

exercicios.enunciado: Summarise this evaluation in English: "A Rosa é organizada e cumpre sempre os prazos. Este ano, preparou o orçamento da empresa pela primeira vez. A melhorar: falar nas reuniões."
exercicios.frase: It says
exercicios.resposta: It says Rosa is organised, and she always meets her deadlines. This year she prepared the company budget for the first time. One thing to improve: speaking in meetings.

opcoes.texto: I've been knowing Lerato since January.

Could you tell me what time starts the meeting?

opcoes.texto: I started this job two years ago.

opcoes.texto: I enjoy to work with clients.

exercicios.enunciado: Já não danço kizomba.
exercicios.resposta: I don't dance kizomba any more.

exercicios.frase: I'm Patrick. I've been learning Portuguese for a year, because my team speaks Portuguese.
exercicios.enunciado: Why is Patrick learning Portuguese?
Compare your life now with five years ago.
exercicios.frase: used to
exercicios.resposta: Five years ago, I used to live in Lobito, and I used to take the bus to work. Now I live in Luanda, and I've been driving to work since last year.
exercicios.contexto: used to e present perfect continuous.

exercicios.enunciado: Tell me about your week: one activity and one result.
exercicios.frase: I've
exercicios.resposta: This week I've been preparing a presentation for a client. I've finished the slides, and I've sent them to my manager.
exercicios.contexto: As duas formas do present perfect.
